versions.localizedDescription:
Important: accounts now need your own Firebase project

SceneBox no longer connects to a shared Firebase project. Sign-in, profiles and sync between devices now run on a free Firebase project that you create and own. Your data stays in your own account, not mine.

- Guest mode still works without any setup. Everything is kept on the device.
- To sign in, tap Connect Firebase on the sign-in screen and import the GoogleService-Info.plist from your Firebase project (on Apple TV, type in the values). Step-by-step guide and the security rules: https://github.com/donbytyqi/scenebox#firebase-setup
- Accounts made on the old shared project don't carry over. Create a new account on your own project.
- Profile photos need Firebase Storage, which requires Google's Blaze plan (it has a free tier). Everything else works on the free Spark plan.

New

- Support SceneBox page in Settings, for anyone who wants to donate.

Fixes

- Downloading a second episode from a season pack works now. Before, every episode of a pack counted as the same download, so you had to delete the finished one before the next would start. (#9)
- Apple TV: Trakt lists open when you click them. (#10)
- Mac: signing in works on the unsigned build. macOS doesn't let unsigned apps use the Keychain, so the app keeps your sign-in session and any API keys you enter in a file inside its own sandbox container instead (readable only by your user account).

Still open

- A few people report that on iPhone the app closes shortly after a stream starts buffering. I can't reproduce it on the simulator or on Mac. If it hits you, please share the crash log: Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements > Analytics Data, look for a file starting with SceneBox, and attach it to the issue. Also say which iPhone and what you were playing (torrent or debrid, resolution). 1.0.2 doesn't have this problem if you need a fallback.
- Apple TV install failing in Sideloadly with "ApplicationVerificationFailed / Invalid file" on tvOS 26.6 (#8). The tvOS build is packaged exactly like 1.0.2 and passes Apple's bundle verification here, so this needs the full Sideloadly log: the "Invalid file" line names the file it choked on. Please paste that on the issue. Sideloadly also has known trouble with tvOS 26.4 and later (pairing), so try the latest Sideloadly first.

Important: this release is NOT signed. You have to allow it yourself.

Nothing here is signed with an Apple developer account and the Mac app is not notarized. macOS and iOS will refuse to open it until you explicitly allow it. This is expected, it's not broken.

Mac:

1. Open the dmg and drag SceneBox to Applications.
2. Open SceneBox. macOS will say it "could not verify" the app or that it's from an unidentified developer. Press Done (not Move to Trash).
3. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security and press "Open Anyway" next to SceneBox, then confirm.
4. From then on it opens normally.

If you'd rather skip the dialog, run this in Terminal after copying the app to Applications:

    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/SceneBox.app

If you had an older signed version installed, delete it first.

iPhone/iPad: the ipa isn't signed, you sign it yourself with Sideloadly, AltStore, SideStore, Feather or ESign with your own Apple ID. Free Apple ID = resign every 7 days (AltStore/SideStore do it for you), paid dev account = one year.

A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### ✨ New Features

- Added **Per-category settings for sort and filters** to the Library, including changes made offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Added notifications when a new Tsumiru or server version is out, with **Remind later** and **Ignore** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Offset double spreads** to the paged reader for spreads that start on an odd page (@PainTownblue)

### ⚙️ Changes

- Made long strip taps and keys scroll by **Scroll distance** instead of a whole page (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed **Keep screen on** to off by default (@aaronbamblett)
- Added Up and Down page turns in horizontal paged mode and N and P to change chapter (@aaronbamblett)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Hid empty category tabs while searching or filtering the library, with **Show empty categories during search/filtering** to keep them (@aaronbamblett)
- Moved **Create registration code** to **Manage users** and added an **Edit** button to user rows (@aaronbamblett)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed the offline library not opening when Tsumiru starts without a connection (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Something went wrong** showing on every page while reading offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed library covers going blank in Safari after scrolling them off screen and back (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the paged reader restoring an old zoom when you return to a page (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed saved searches from older WebUI versions not loading (@aaronbamblett)

*Thanks to our Weblate translators: Damien O'Neil for French, Kisnov for Catalan, Andrei Stepanov for Russian and PainTownblue for Chinese.*

## Install

You'll need a running Suwayomi server. See [Getting started](https://tsumiru.app/docs/guides/getting-started).

### Mobile

**Android:** download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

**iOS:** the `…-ios.ipa` below is unsigned and has to be sideloaded. Add `https://tsumiru.app/apps.json` as a source in [SideStore](https://sidestore.io/) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io/) to install it and get later releases as updates.

<details>
<summary>Which sideloading tool should I use?</summary>

- **[SideStore](https://sidestore.io/)** signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
- **[AltStore](https://altstore.io/)** expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
- **[TrollStore](https://ios.cfw.guide/installing-trollstore/)** installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.
</details>

### Desktop

**Windows:** download `…-windows-x64.zip`, extract it anywhere, and run `tsumiru.exe`.

**macOS:** download `…-macos-universal.zip`, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

**Linux:** the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumiru https://flatpak.tsumiru.app/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumiru app.tsumiru.Tsumiru
```

Existing Flatpak installs keep receiving updates under `io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru`; no data, settings or logins move. AppImage/deb also keep that ID.

For a portable option, download `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, mark it executable with `chmod +x`, and run it.

### Web

Download `…-web.zip` and serve its contents with any static web server.

[Full documentation](https://tsumiru.app/)

versions.localizedDescription:
## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.

## Changes (v5.0.8)
* Fixed several changes listed for v5.0.7 being left out of that build by mistake.
* (macOS) Fixed Windows 3D acceleration on Apple Silicon Macs without Rosetta by falling back to DXMT
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed Windows installs from the USB CD drive stalling repeatedly, which made them much slower in v5.0.7 (#7970)

## Changes (v5.0.7)
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends with fixes for Windows 3D acceleration
* ~~QEMU: Windows guests now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 60 Hz, which also fixes 3D acceleration failing on displays faster than 125 Hz (#7820)~~ This was dropped and will be included in the next update.
* QEMU: Fixed VirtIO GPU stalls that hung Windows at shutdown, stalled 3D benchmarks on Linux, and could leave the Windows 3D driver without a display
* Snapshots: Fixed saving and restoring the state of VMs with compressed disks (#7916)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 27.1) Support for iPhone Duo: the VM toolbar sits in the outer display's camera strip, and a new laptop mode turns the bottom half of the folded screen into a keyboard or touchpad
* (macOS) Fixed headless VMs keeping the Mac from sleeping after they were paused or stopped
* (macOS) Closing a VM window or quitting UTM while a VM runs now confirms with "Close" or "Quit" instead of "OK"
* (macOS) Fixed shaders using instancing or integer vertex attributes drawing incorrectly with the Apple Core OpenGL backend (#7944)
* (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for DirectX 12
* (macOS) Display: The option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen is now available on macOS 12 and later (#6183)
* (macOS) Wizard: Fixed the Name field's focus ring being clipped on the summary page (thanks @dnicolson)

apps.name: VeneraNext
apps.subtitle: 跨平台漫画阅读器
apps.localizedDescription: 基于 Flutter 的跨平台漫画阅读器，支持本地漫画、WebDAV 漫画源与第三方网络漫画源，支持 Android、iOS、Windows、Linux、macOS 平台。

versions.localizedDescription:
### 正式版与升级

- 发布正式版 `1.18.3+249`，集中交付收藏操作、目录导航、归档兼容和依赖解耦后的构建，运行时代码沿用已验收的 RC3。Android 手机／TV、Windows、macOS、iOS、Linux x64／ARM64 与鸿蒙从同一正式版提交重新构建；保留历史标签，不复用或重命名候选安装包。
- 稳定更新渠道推进至本版；AltStore 与 Winget 元数据依据实际公开安装包更新，Winget 公共源收录需等待 Microsoft 审核。iOS IPA 与鸿蒙 HAP 仍需自行签名侧载。
- 升级前导出并另存完整应用数据备份，保留原漫画文件。共享 WebDAV 数据的设备统一使用兼容版本；回退使用升级前的备份，不让旧版覆盖新版收藏库。覆盖升级保留原数据，无需清库或重新导入。

### 鸿蒙随版分发

- 正式版继续包含同版本的鸿蒙 ARM64 未签名测试版 HAP、`harmonyos-manifest.json`、`harmonyos-SHA256SUMS` 和中英文安装指南。应用源码与平台适配统一在 `main`；普通平台使用官方 Flutter 和根锁，鸿蒙使用独立固定 Flutter OH SDK、CPF 覆盖与受控锁模板。
- 鸿蒙应用为 `VeneraNext (HarmonyOS Beta)`，包名为 `com.github.cyrilpeng.veneranext.harmony`，最低／目标 SDK 为 API 26，版本为 `1.18.3`，构建号为 249。升级须沿用原签名身份／密钥，同一助手或账号不保证同一把密钥。
- 鸿蒙本地导入支持系统提供的目录选择、多选归档，以及带一层可选外部总目录的「漫画合集 ZIP」；结构有多本漫画／单本多章节歧义时由用户确认，取消不入库。目录仅复制导入，PDF 导入、系统分享及生物认证等限制见安装指南。
- 每次候选版与正式版均要求鸿蒙构建成功，准确源码、版本、原生库、资源和全部五项附件须通过生成资产、GitHub 草稿及公开资产核验；缺包或摘要不一致阻止整次发布。草稿按完整分页列表定位唯一标签，再按发布 ID 核验，发布源码与生成产物使用隔离目录。
- 鸿蒙继续标记未签名 Beta，manifest 保留 `signed: false` 和 `runtime_verified: false`。本轮没有鸿蒙真机；构建及资产审核不代表设备签装、阅读、真实数据迁移、覆盖升级或续签已经验收。

### 修复与改进

- 修复 Android 收藏侧栏关闭新建弹窗后不能连续新建的问题；支持收藏夹仅修改名称大小写，保留目录标识、层级、内容、网络关联和追更设置，失败完整回滚。新建与导入按 SQLite 的 ASCII 大小写规则识别重名，自动命名避开占用名称（#143）。
- 收藏子目录返回时先关闭弹窗、退出搜索或多选，再进入真实父目录；保存目录选择期间的返回正常处理。工具栏父目录路径可以点击跳转，窄屏提供上一级按钮，大字体保留完整名称提示；名称中的 `/` 不作为层级数据。保持两级限制及现有备份／同步格式（#123，PR #144）。
- 修复导航容器重建时替换封面转场控制器的问题，控制器与嵌套导航器共用生命周期，取消返回手势及移除导航器时清理悬浮层。这是已确认的生命周期路径修复，原 Android 偶发封面悬浮仍需新版复测（#129）。
- 新导入同时避开本地库和各收藏夹已占用的同类型漫画 ID，未选收藏夹的导入也不会误关联残留收藏。保留旧记录、原文件与双库原子提交；存储不可读时拒绝冒险复用 ID。
- 适配 `archive 4.6.0`，应用备份与 CBZ 的 Dart 解压显式校验 CRC、解压大小和目录完整性。损坏或截断的备份在替换活动数据前失败，保留原收藏、设置及正常重试能力。
- 从 ZIP 原始文件名字节识别未标记的 UTF-8 和 GBK 中文名称，保留标准 UTF-8、有效 Unicode Path 扩展和 CP437 回退；合法 Unicode 名称不再被二次猜测编码，仍执行原有路径安全校验。
- 官方滚动列表首次尚未通知页码边界时，像素滚动代理立即绑定唯一活动列表，修复早期读取滚动偏移没有客户端的问题；远距离跳页和双列表动画仍按当前几何归属处理。
- 鸿蒙更新说明可滚动，横屏大字体下完整显示同密钥覆盖升级提示；文件／目录临时副本、实际网络请求及取消继续按应用生命周期清理。

### 依赖与维护

- 依赖优先采用官方稳定版，其次固定官方完整 commit，仅保留必要本地补丁。滚动列表回归官方 `0.3.8`，InAppWebView 使用审核后的官方提交，Windows 单包保留实例所有权补丁；SQLite 更新至 `2.9.4`、shimmer_animation 至 `2.2.2+1`。
- 精确保留兼容的官方 `dynamic_color 1.8.1`、网格 `5.7.0` 和 `pdfrx 2.4.7`，本次不扩大 Flutter SDK 更新范围；更新 `crypto`、`image` 和 `archive` 的锁定版本，保持 Flutter Rust Bridge `2.11.1`。
- 必要补丁包与自编 `venera_native`／`venera_saf` 随项目管理，来源、许可证、完整摘要和退出条件纳入校验。PNG 使用官方 LodePNG 20241015，7z 使用 7-Zip 24.09 的已声明 C 解码子集；保留原有算法、版权和逐字节整数读取。
- SAF 保留 Android 文档路径、持久授权、64 位操作、句柄 generation、isolate 交接及关闭／取消清理；QuickJS 固定到 `f5a1f20` 的必要核心安全回移，保留 Map、TypedData、Promise、dispatch 和 port 契约。真实 Provider、原生内存安全、图片处理及反复退出继续作为 CI 门禁。
- Issue 入口按崩溃／启动、阅读性能、导入／数据、网络／WebDAV、界面／其他缺陷和功能建议分类；按情形要求脱敏日志或手动诊断，纯界面与建议使用截图和验收标准。自动检查维护分类与缺失信息提示，材料补齐后更新原提示，保留人工跟进状态。
- 发布元数据、更新日志和正式版验收文档同步至 `1.18.3+249`。主线发版尝试已合为一个提交，本次版本准备单独保留一个中文约定式提交；运行时代码与依赖锁保持已验证的候选内容。

### 已知范围与后续反馈

- #143 的连续新建／仅改大小写与 #129 的原 Android 偶发封面悬浮仍需原设备新版反馈；自动化通过和独立 Android 覆盖升级验证不等于所有设备症状已解决，发布不会自动关闭报告。
- #115 原 Android「导入成功但不可见」的完整根因仍在调查。已提供的设备信息和附件继续复用；新版若仍出现，只需补充实际导入结果、隐藏提示及重启前后变化，有具体新错误再提供必要脱敏片段。
- 收藏目录仍为两级；更深层级、选择器和跨层拖动继续跟进 #123。收藏夹右上角的排序仅操作该目录直接收藏的漫画；同级子目录可在收藏侧栏「排序」中选择父目录后调整，入口说明的完善继续跟进 #155。
- 鸿蒙设备签装、完整功能、真实数据升级及续签仍按实际使用反馈验收；#152 多选入口、#81 分卷 CBZ、#139 白边裁剪作为后续独立需求。

apps.subtitle: File manager for iOS 26 and 27 (worse_query)
apps.localizedDescription: File browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 26 and 27, built on the worse_query sandbox technique. Browse other apps' containers, edit plists, hex and SQLite databases, and back up, restore or clear app data without a jailbreak or kernel exploit.

versions.localizedDescription:
> **Requires:** iOS 27, or iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1, 26.7.1 and the 27.3 beta (confirmed by a user).
> **Needs:** a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see [Signing](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#signing-the-app-group) in the README.

# Worse Query Files 0.9.6

## New

- **Search Inside Folders…** (••• menu): finds names in all subfolders, with progress and **Stop**.
- **Largest Files** (••• menu): the 100 biggest files below a folder, to see where storage goes.
- **Get Info** (long-press): path, kind, size (folders counted), dates, owner, permissions, inode and a file's SHA-256. Tap a row to copy it.
- **Duplicate** and **Copy to Folder…** (long-press): copy files and folders, also into other apps' data, like Move.
- **Favorites:** add a folder from its ••• menu; they're listed under Tools.
- **Reopen Last Folder** ([#41](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/41)): WQ Files starts in the folder you were in. It's a switch on the start screen.
- **Check for Updates** ([#41](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/41)): a note on the start screen when a new version is out.
  - **What's sent:** WQ Files reads the public release list on GitHub at most twice a day and sends nothing about your device. This is its only network access.
  - **Turning it off:** use the switch on the start screen.
- **Open ZIP files by tapping them** ([#41](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/41)): **Extract and Open** unpacks it next to itself and opens the folder. **Open as File** shows the file as before.
- **Thai** ([#52](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/52)).

## Changed

- **SQLite save** writes through SQLite itself, which takes care of the database's journal and WAL files, so a save is safer if WQ Files is closed midway.
- **App restore** copies and checks the backup in a private folder first, and installs exactly what was checked.
- **Replace All** when importing only replaces the file versions shown in the question; a file that changed meanwhile is imported under a new name.
- **Turkish and Thai:** clearer wording.

## Fixed

- **App names and some app folders missing** on some devices (e.g. iOS 26.1): when the app database uses a layout WQ Files doesn't know, it now works out where names and folders are from the database itself, and remembers it for that iOS version. App identities, which decide where backups go, still only come from the app's own folder tag or a known layout. WQ Files also uses the newest database file when iOS keeps an old one, and the Log lists them.
- **App backups could come out empty** when WQ Files didn't have access to the app's folder yet; it worked on the second or third try. Backup now fails with "try again" instead, and an empty backup is never restored (restoring one would empty the app's data).

## Credit

Sandbox technique: [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) by Taj C (forcequit). Container enumeration: [KAMUI](https://github.com/murk-sus/kamui-escape) by murk-sus. Translations: iosrxwy (Simplified Chinese), hfip (Arabic), hooray804 (Korean), Reinascape (Russian). Thanks to everyone who sent Logs and ideas. GPL-3.0-or-later.

SHA-256 of WQFiles.ipa: `d15feaf0fb82dd754b78de3a0e9d210db0cc1ebd83748dd1980e922d2183c2c6`

versions.localizedDescription:
## 🛡️ WQGuard v1.2.1 — 安全加固正式版 / Security Hardening Release

纯 Swift 5.9+ 原生开发、零第三方依赖、100% 本地离线运行的 iOS 静态二进制沙盒逃逸审计工具与多端网络降级护盾。
A native, zero-dependency, 100% offline iOS static binary sandbox-escape auditor and multi-client HTTP Brotli downgrade shield written in pure Swift 5.9+.

---

### 🔥 核心更新与安全修复 / Highlights & Security Fixes (v1.2.1)

1. **CSBlob 双槽（XML + Apple CoreEntitlements DER）完整解码与防遮蔽合并**
   - 完整实现 Apple `CoreEntitlements` v1 (`0xfade7172`) `[APPLICATION 16]` (`0x70`)、`[CONTEXT 16]` (`0xb0`) 及 ITU-T X.690 多字节高 Tag ASN.1 DER 解析，并与 XML 槽位 (`0xfade7171`) 跨切片递归合并数组与布尔权限，彻底阻断“在 XML 槽写入空数组或 `<false/>` 遮蔽 DER 槽真实越权项”的静态审计绕过。
2. **Mach-O 全 ARM 切片并集审计 + ObjC 选择器提取 + 全量 `.appex` 扩展深扫**
   - 对 Universal/FAT 二进制取全部可执行 ARM 切片（`arm64` + `arm64e` 等）的并集进行符号、字符串与 `__objc_methname` 选择器提取，防止 `arm64` 良性壳遮蔽 `arm64e` 恶意载荷。
   - 覆盖主程序、`Frameworks/`、`.app/Dylibs/`、`.app/DynamicLibraries/` 以及 `PlugIns/*.appex` 与 iOS 16+ `Extensions/*.appex` 全部扩展的独立 CSBlob 权限与二进制静态审计；原生支持 `.ipa` 与 `.tipa` 包。
   - 无 App Group 权限但调用 `fsgetpath` / `container_object_get_path` 等沙盒侦察原语的样本前置直接标定高危（`CM-05` / `bad_query`）。
3. **沙盒按需隔离解包与 64 KB 流式配额加固**
   - 组件级路径穿越拦截（支持合法双点文件名如 `icon..png`，阻断 `../` 越界）、64 KB 分块流式 `inflate` 单条目与全包累计解压配额熔断（兼容 ZIP64 `0x0001` 扩展头并拦截 0 字节伪造头部膨胀炸弹），以及临时隔离区 `S_IFLNK` 逃逸符号链接强制剥离。
4. **第三方侧载工具严格零信任策略（Strict Zero-Trust Policy）**
   - 移除对所有第三方侧载器与开发辅助工具（`Feather`、`SideStore`、`AltStore`、`ESign / 全能签`、`GBox`、`Scarlet`、`TrollStore`、`LocalDevVPN`、`StikDebug` 等）的任何内置默认白名单豁免（一律列入前置留意或按命中载荷定级）；内置白名单仅对 `WQGuard` 本身执行精确 Bundle ID、全量 App Group 与全量威胁指标子集强校验。
   - 支持中英混排与驼峰边界的品牌仿冒词元匹配（同时消除对 `NetGuard`、`PostgREST`、`GitGraph`、`ZeroTrust` 等合法应用的误报），并强制 `LockdownInstProxyClient` STARTTLS 叶子证书钉扎校验 Fail-Closed。
5. **五大代理客户端 Brotli 降级护盾（`CVE-2026-111497`）与固件补丁基线校准**
   - 修复 Surge `.sgmodule` 远程 `script-path` 挂载规范，统一加固 Surge / Shadowrocket / Loon / Stash / Quantumult X 响应头拦截脚本（大小写无关遍历与重复头合并检测，返回顶层 `403` 零响应体解压阻断）。
   - 固件雷达新增识别 Apple 官方在 `iOS 27.0`、`iOS 26.7.1` 与 `iOS 18.7.11` 发布的 `CVE-2026-86950` 安全回移植补丁基线。
   - *防御边界提示*：代理层护盾管辖标准 HTTP/1.1 & HTTP/2 头部协商；若面临高危定向威胁，建议在客户端禁用 QUIC/HTTP3 并叠加开启 iOS 系统「锁定模式（Lockdown Mode）」以禁用 WebKit `.woff2` 网页字体渲染。

versions.localizedDescription:
iOS 27 only. Unsigned build - it contains no signing material, no profile and no team ID.

- `WQToolkit-unsigned.ipa` - 4.6 MB. Re-sign it with your own developer identity and an App Group entitlement before installing.
- `WQToolkit_source.tar.gz` - source snapshot (Xcode project included).

No jailbreak, no Mac at runtime. The app only reaches its own containers and its own App Groups; cross-app access is out of scope.

Tested on iPhone 15 Pro Max, iOS 27.3.
